Publication statement: Hamburg : Bey Carl Ernst Bohn, 1797.

Relief shown by hachures. Shows longitude west from Greenwich and east from Washington. Shows counties and minor civil subdivisions. Both copies mounted on cloth. At upper right corner: No. IX.
